headline: One picture, 2 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 2 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 2 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 6 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.009 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): d53b0822f0c8 on 1 work, f66e458809a2 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (2).
All 2 works report the same GPS point (13.64023, 77.395419).
The picture was uploaded 4 times within 20 minutes (2025-12-18 11:03:42 to 2025-12-18 11:23:01).
